execution_environment_policy: Production execution strictly forbidden. Run only on Supabase preview branch or ephemeral local PostgreSQL.

checks.detail: Functions must have SECURITY DEFINER and isolated search_path = wf_canonical_staging, pg_catalog
Must use function-specific revocations rather than global revocations
Timestamp and date columns must use explicit USING expressions
Scoped check constraints for hashes, prices, ordinals, intent, reconciliation category, and statuses must be present
Separate active partial unique indexes for parent-level and child-level images
Customer-safe detail RPC must not return unredacted raw_message; internal evidence RPC must be separate
JSONB array type must be validated before array iteration or length calculation
